$provenance: Verbatim `terraform providers schema -json` output for hashicorp/azurerm 4.81.0, reduced to the resource types the tests need so it can live in git: every type the curated catalog declares (so the derived reference rule can be compared against hand-written connections), plus azurerm_kubernetes_cluster as the largest thing the catalog will ever store. Nothing inside a kept entry is edited - the point of the fixture is that it is the provider's own word. Regenerate with `terraform init` on a config pinning the version, then `terraform providers schema -json`.
